document: per-finding disposition of the Codex review of owned_supervisor_v5 in owned_supervisor_v7 (written only; nothing executed)
author: ContinueRQLS10b

shared_lessons_source.note: read only; PA19 files not edited

folded_from_v6: running sha256 digests of samples and both sinks plus the published launch-record sha256, re-checked at settlement (EVIDENCE_MUTATED); v6 itself is superseded and was never run

kernel_sources_consulted.note: public apple-oss-distributions/xnu main, downloaded into lane tmp/ for citation
facts_used: p_uniqueid = ++nextuniqueid at fork; copied unchanged on exec (kern_fork.c)
p_puniqueid set in pinsertchild at fork (kern_proc.c); proc_reparentlocked changes p_pptr and p_ppid only (kern_exit.c)
PROC_PIDUNIQIDENTIFIERINFO 17 = struct proc_uniqidentifierinfo, 56 bytes, p_uniqueid at 16, p_puniqueid at 24, p_idversion at 32 (proc_info_private.h); no same-user check (proc_info.c)
nonzero arg finds zombies for flavors 3, 13, 17, 18 (proc_info.c)
proc_listpgrppids returns a count; proc_listpids returns 0 on error (libproc.c)

findings.title: live escaped descendant can coexist with SETTLED
findings.v7: lineage census by uniqueid: every observed (uniqueid -> puniqueid) is remembered; OWNED/OTHER/UNRESOLVED classification relative to the child's uniqueid U0 (Sup._class, Sup.census); a process whose parent was never observed and has uniqueid > U0 (dead intermediate of a fast double fork) is UNRESOLVED and blocks settlement, whatever its cwd, argv, session or uid; the lane-path baseline rule of v5 is removed; one complete census after spawn is required before GO
findings.residual: UNRESOLVED processes of unrelated programs forked through short-lived intermediates after U0 also block (fail-closed, spurious UNSETTLED possible)

findings.title: zombies treated as vanished
findings.v7: short_info, uniq_info and bsd_start pass arg=1 (zombie-inclusive); zombies stay in the census and block while OWNED, UNRESOLVED or in the child group (blocking_zombies recorded); only this supervisor reaps its own children

findings.title: partial metadata failures fail open
findings.v7: exclusion from the lane needs a successful cwd read AND a completely parsed argv (argc count of NUL-terminated strings) without a match; one positive read includes; any other unreadable same-uid process raises (census failure, latched); every listed pid must yield short and uniqueid records (ESRCH = gone; uniqueid re-read to exclude pid reuse); bsd/task info errors raise; no pid:None identities exist

findings.title: failure paths reach SETTLED
findings.v7: single monotonic failure latch (Sup.fail): census, free-space, output-size, lane-walk, stream, samples, helper (any non-OK outcome), identity, signal, GO delivery (GO written+flushed AND stdin closed), launch record, grace expiry and exceptions; a launched run is SETTLED only with an empty latch

findings.title: post-spawn exceptions abandon the child
findings.v7: child registered and identity captured immediately after Popen, before thread setup; everything after spawn runs in run_supervised inside try/except BaseException -> failure latched, identity-checked stop, emergency_observe (bounded by settle_s), finalize with its own exception path that still publishes an UNSETTLED settlement record; samples write errors are caught (SAMPLES_WRITE_FAILED) and request a stop

findings.title: observation not bounded by grace
findings.v7: hash_regular: lstat/fstat-agreeing regular files only (FIFOs refused), O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK, byte limit, monotonic time budget, no growth or change; walk_bytes entry and time budgets; helper stdout read non-blocking after reaping (<= 257 bytes); write_all progress and time checks; publish re-reads bounded
findings.residual: native libproc/sysctl/statvfs/listdir calls are not time-bounded from Python (as stated in the HOLD)

findings.title: grace expiry not irreversible
findings.v7: grace decisions read a fresh time.monotonic(); expiry latches GRACE_EXPIRED_AFTER_STOP_REQUEST / _AFTER_CHILD_EXIT / _AFTER_EXCEPTION as failures; later cleanup cannot clear the latch

findings.title: signal safety relies on unenforced reaping; helpers lack identity
findings.v7: SIGCHLD reset to SIG_DFL before any spawn; Popen objects kept referenced and never polled/waited; reaping only via os.waitpid(pid, WNOHANG); ECHILD -> WAIT_STATUS_LOST failure and no further signals; identity tuple (pid, uniqueid, idversion, pgid, uid) re-read equal immediately before killpg for the child and for /bin/date helpers
findings.residual: Popen finalizers may poll at interpreter exit, after publication

findings.title: failed publication can leave an authoritative-looking SETTLED file
findings.v7: settlement record written completely to NAME.staged (exclusive, fsync, verified) then hard-linked to NAME (atomic), directory fsync, re-read; the record states it is not authoritative until the parent commit (exit code + stdout summary + verified receipt and settlement sha256); require_settled removed: the supervisor never treats an earlier record as authority

findings.title: config validation does not enforce hard policy
findings.v7: strict_json (duplicate keys, NaN/Infinity, non-finite numbers rejected) on the exact hashed bytes; exact key sets; bounds: lane ceiling and output trip <= 10737418240, free_trip >= 12e9, launch free minimum >= 12.2e9, busy_limit in [1, 2], rss_trip <= 48 GiB, durations positive and bounded, reservations >= 0, reservation >= caps + output trip + 4 MiB, normalized absolute paths, output roots strictly under lane_disk_root and not nested

findings.title: reservation and disk accounting incomplete
findings.v7: runtime ceiling check keeps this run's unused reservation (reservation minus bytes written); lane_disk_baseline removed; TMPDIR, output roots and evidence must lie under lane_disk_root; fresh free-floor check before final publication (FINAL_FREE_BELOW_FLOOR); reservations and busy slots are allocated and released only by the parent's serialized itemGO (GO names this config sha256 and the exact reservation values); no second ledger
findings.residual: sampling cannot stop child writes between samples; the child's own caps and the reservation are the bound

findings.title: admission stale at the launch boundary
findings.v7: commit_boundary immediately before spawn: fresh /bin/date and stability age, GO expiry, free space, cancel, latched failures and chunk fit including settle_s and FINALIZE_ALLOWANCE_S; GO additionally requires no cancel, no stop, no latched failure and spawn <= GO_MAX_DELAY_S ago

findings.title: exclusive creation and evidence binding incomplete
findings.v7: config sha256 of the parsed bytes; output roots opened once as O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW fds, required EMPTY at admission (one use per GO entry), device/inode and directory chain re-checked at settlement; all supervisor files created with O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW through the root fds; inventory must hold only declared names (UNDECLARED_ENTRIES); child outputs must be regular, one link, born after spawn; launch record, samples and sinks compared with the supervisor's own digests

findings.title: busy excess tolerated for one sample
findings.v7: BUSY trips on the first observed excess; first-seen processes use CPU since process start
findings.residual: the limit is sampled, not enforced between samples

findings.title: final helper accounting order
findings.v7: the final /bin/date runs first in _finalize; counts, logs and clocks are snapshotted after it

pa19_shared_lessons_applied: one identity-verified group SIGTERM, never speculative (already v7 item 4)

helpers: identity tuple, bounded wait on a monotonic clock, non-blocking capped read, group empty after reaping (HELPER_GROUP_LIVE_OR_UNREADABLE), not started after a latched failure, refused after the chunk limit
reservations released only by the parent after its commit; single parent allocator + one-use admission (GO names this config sha256; output roots must be empty)
deadline compliance required for SETTLED (DEADLINE_NOT_ENFORCED_IN_TIME) and decision before the chunk limit (SETTLEMENT_PAST_CHUNK_LIMIT)
bounded regular-file reads for all metadata inputs (GO, stability receipt, config, pins)
creation anchored to validated directory fds; digests for exact-byte evidence
cancellation arriving after the loop recorded at the decision boundary (SUPERVISOR_CANCEL_LATE)

parent_interface_changes.authority: parent commit after verifying exit code, summary line, receipt and settlement sha256; parent releases the reservation
